final_message:
Configured pc21 as the lab DNS server, with address records for all requested machines and MX records for company.com and university.edu. All PCs and routers now use it for DNS; existing addresses, routes, and connections are unchanged.

The configuration and usage notes are in [DNS.md](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-4gn8n2v9/lab/DNS.md). The MX records identify the mail hosts but do not configure mail services on them.

All startup scripts passed shell syntax checks, and the records were checked against the machines’ configured addresses. I could not run the lab or test live DNS queries because Kathara and BIND are unavailable in this environment; the lab image must provide BIND’s `named` executable.
